description: Spawn bots that plugins treat as real players. kind: plugin (fake player in a Paper server, default), java or bedrock (protocol clients from a bot runner; need address). Up to 1000 per call; group names them. Returns {spawned, names:"Bot1..Bot50"}. More (perTick, spread, profile, settings, netsim, auth, …): craftwire://docs/tools.
